headline: Silvercorp Metals Reports Q2 Fiscal 2027 Results
summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. reported an adjusted net income of $18.4 million, or $0.08 per share, for the second quarter of fiscal 2027. Operating cash flow for the period was $62.7 million.
why: Silvercorp Metals is a mining company focused on silver, lead, and zinc production. Its financial results are sensitive to fluctuations in precious and base metal prices.
